headline: Approved exterior renovations at 2 Woodland Road with conditions; ratified demolition-review determinations for 101 Wallace Street and 14 Julia Street.
summary: Found 2 Woodland Road to be a Significant Building, then a Preferably Preserved Building, and approved its exterior renovations with two conditions. Ratified determinations of significance for accessory garages at 101 Wallace Street and 14 Julia Street. Requested revised façade plans for the 15 Ferry Street project and took the matter under advisement.
decisions: Determined 2 Woodland Road is a Significant Building, motion passed 5-0.
Waived the public hearing for 2 Woodland Road, motion passed 5-0.
Determined 2 Woodland Road is a Preferably Preserved Building, motion passed 5-0.
Approved the proposed exterior alterations at 2 Woodland Road with two conditions, motion passed 5-0.
Requested revised façade plans for 15 Ferry Street and took the matter under advisement.
Ratified Determinations of Significance for 101 Wallace Street and 14 Julia Street, motion passed 5-0.
Approved the minutes of the August 2026 meeting, motion passed 4-0.

The Commission waived the public hearing. On the motion by Salazar, seconded by Jackson, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0).

The Commission reviewed the Ordinance and made the following determination: the building is a Preferably Preserved Building based on Criteria D.III, V, VI, VII, VIII and IX of Title 4.24.110 of the Ordinance. On the motion by Bach, seconded by Salazar, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0).

the Commission approved the proposed alterations, subject to the following conditions: 1. Compliance with Project Narrative and Project Scope (attached) filed with NOI Application. 2. Provide Commission with update (in writing and with photos) when work is completed. On the motion by Bach, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion passed (5-0).

Page 1 of 4 MHC 9/24/26 
   
 
 
 
          
           
    
 
 
MALDEN HISTORICAL COMMISSION 
MEETING MINUTES 
 
Date: Thursday, September 24, 2026 
Location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, Room 105. 
Commissioners in attendance: Inna Babitskaya, Chair; Elizabeth Salazar, Vice Chair; Matthew Bach; 
Keith Jackson; Emma Taddeo (arrived at 5:04 pm); Leonard Iovino, Alternate (arrived at 5:19 pm). 
Commissioners Absent: John Parcellin, Alternate. 
City Staff: Michelle Romero, Clerk to the Commission. 
 
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Babitskaya called the meeting to order at 4:01 pm, took a roll call and chaired the meeting. 
 
Babitskaya read a memorial tribute to former Chair John Tramondozzi and the Commission held a 
moment of silence. 
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
1. 2 Woodland Road, aka, 6 Woodland Road (Parcel ID 014 034 413/Permit # RES-078240-2026. 
Notice of Intent to Alter Inventoried Property (MHC MAL.363) – Exterior renovations (siding, trim 
& casing). Determination of Significance. Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance, Title 4.24, 
MCC. 
 
Owners and applicants, Kevin Mulder and Alyssa Bowling, 2 Woodland Road, Malden, attended the 
meeting and provided paper copies of the Notice of Intent to Alter Application.   
 
The Commission reviewed the NOI Application and the Ordinance. The Commission made the 
following determination: the building is a Significant Building based on Criteria A and C of Title 
4.24.080 of the Ordinance. 
 
On the motion by Salazar, seconded by Bach, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion 
passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, Alternate, 
not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
The Commission asked whether the applicant consented to waive the requirement to hold a public 
hearing and Mulder stated he consented.  The Commission waived the public hearing. 
 
On the motion by Salazar, seconded by Jackson, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the 
motion passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, 
Alternate, not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
                                   
 
City of Malden 
Massachusetts 
 
MALDEN HISTORICAL COMMISSION 
 
215 Pleasant Street, Room 330  
Malden, Massachusetts 02148 
(781) 397-7000 ext. 2044
Page 2 of 4 MHC 9/24/26 
The Commission reviewed the Ordinance and made the following determination: the building is a 
Preferably Preserved Building based on Criteria D.III, V, VI, VII, VIII and IX of Title 4.24.110 of the 
Ordinance. 
 
On the motion by Bach, seconded by Salazar, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion 
passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, Alternate, 
not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
The Commission reviewed the proposed alterations. The Applicant answered the Commission’s 
questions and provided additional details re: the proposed work.  
 
Pursuant to Title 4.24.130.A.3 of the Ordinance, the Commission found that the intent and purpose of 
the Ordinance will be served even with the issuance of the building permit for the proposed 
alterations, and the Commission approved the proposed alterations, subject to the following 
conditions: 
1. Compliance with Project Narrative and Project Scope (attached) filed with NOI Application. 
2. Provide Commission with update (in writing and with photos) when work is completed. 
 
On the motion by Bach, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion 
passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, Alternate, 
not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
2. 15 Ferry Street (Parcel ID 075 272 211)/Permit #CMID-062907-2023. 
New application/Demolition Permit issued March 6, 2024 (Permit #CMID-062907-2023). 
Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24. 
 
15 Ferry Street (Parcel ID 075 272 211)/Permit #CMID-029312-2019. 
Status update for Building Determined to be Preferably Preserved (Determination dated June 6, 2019, 
extended/amended April 21, 2022), (Demolition Permit Application withdrawn May 31, 2022). 
Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24.  
  
One Salem Street (Parcel ID 075 272 209)/Permit #CMID-029311-2019.  
Status Update for Building determined to be Preferably Preserved, Demolition Delay ended 
(Determination dated December 4, 2019, amended January 27, 2020). 
 
Roberto DiMarco, Attorney, 350 Main Street, Malden, on behalf of the petitioner, and William 
Chalfant, architect, KDI Architecture Khalsa Design Inc., Somerville, MA, attended the meeting, 
provided the Commission with an overview of the project and reviewed current façade plans. 
 
The Commission reviewed Condition 1 of the Commission’s December 18, 2025 decision: 
Petitioner’s professionals shall collaborate with the Malden Historical Commission to incorporate as 
many of the exterior elements of 15 Ferry Street building into the interior and exterior and Ferry 
Street façade of the new building; and its Determinations dated January 27, 2020 re: 15 Ferry Street 
and One Salem Street. 
 
The Commission received comments and recommendations in writing from Maria Schroeder, 
architect and Planning Board member, via correspondence dated September 10, 2026 and verbal 
testimony from Schroeder at the meeting.
Page 3 of 4 MHC 9/24/26 
The Commission requested corrections to information provided on Sheet A-311, “15 Ferry 
Integration Idea,” dated December 18, 2025, contained in the set of plans, “Project: Salem Street 
Mixed Use, Special Permit Set- 3-18-2026.” 
 
The Commission requested façade plans be revised to include comments discussed, including, 
regarding the public walkway/arcade, recessed spandrels on 2nd and 3rd floors, scale of arched 
windows, simplifying top floors above historic portion and incorporation of 15 Ferry Street; 
petitioner’s attorney and architect agreed to provide; and the Commission took the matter under 
advisement. 
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
3. Historical Preservation Program. Educational Outreach.  
Gerard Tannetta, Director, History/Social Studies Dept., Malden High School, attended this meeting. 
 
The Commission and Director Tannetta discussed the Commission’s Proposal for a School–Historical 
Commission Partnership to Advance Historic Preservation and Civic Engagement and discussed ideas 
and options for student involvement. 
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
4. 101 Wallace Street (Parcel ID 089 829 919)/Permit # CMID-076877-2026. 
Notice of Intent to Demolish Accessory Garage. Determination of Significance dated September 17, 
2026.  Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24. 
 
5. 14 Julia Street (Parcel ID 037 178 804)/Permit # RES-077959-2026.  
Notice of Intent to Demolish Accessory Garage. Determination of Significance dated September 21, 
2026.  Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24. 
 
The Commission ratified and confirmed the Determinations of Significance made by Romero as the 
Commission’s delegate pursuant to Section 4.24.070.A of the Ordinance. 
 
On the motion by Bach, seconded by Salazar, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion 
passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, Alternate, 
not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
6. 245 Bryant Street (Parcel ID 097 424 414) Permit #CMID-069419-2024. 
Status Update for Building determined to be Preferably Preserved.  
Demolition Delay ended (Determination dated January 23, 2025, amended March 20, 2025). 
Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance/Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24. 
 
No update received from petitioner. Romero provided an update re: permitting status of the project.  
 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
7. 808 Salem Street (Parcel ID 133 663 317) Permit # CMID-040128-2021. 
Notice of Intent to Alter Building (Inventoried MHC MAL. 32) (deck & balcony addition, 
replacement window, four-family dwelling). Status Update (Determination of Significance dated 
November 20, 2025, Preferably Preserved Status dated March 19, 2026).
Page 4 of 4 MHC 9/24/26 
Determination of Significance.  Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance (MCC, Title 4.24) 
 
The Commission received a written update with photograph re: the balcony/deck project from Re 
Dawn Wu, property owner, via emails dated September 7 and 17, 2026. 
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
8. Historical Preservation Program.  
The Commission received an updated version of “Malden’s Historic Losses, An Illustrated  Record of 
the Buildings and Neighborhoods Malden has Lost,” prepared by the Chair. 
 
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
9. Next meeting:  Monday, October 26, 2026 at 5 pm.   
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Bach left the meeting at 7:02 pm and Iovino left the meeting at 7:08 pm. 
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
10. Approval of Minutes.  
The Commission reviewed and approved the minutes of the August 2026 meeting. 
On the motion by Salazar, seconded by Jackson, four voted in favor, none in opposition, and the 
motion passed (4-0). (Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Bach, Iovino, 
Parcellin, absent). 
 
           -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
11. Adjournment:  7:16 pm. On the motion of Salazar, seconded by Taddeo, four voted in favor, none in 
opposition, and the motion passed (4-0). (Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes, Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; 
Bach, Iovino, Parcellin, absent). 
 
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
          
Inna Babitskaya, Chair
